strategy.title: No executable plan: ballast-water record packs have no established way to reach the buyer
strategy.why: Price ($2,500), demand signal, Brain-produced delivery at $50, $0 exposure and 14-day time to cash are evidenced and two deals would carry $5,000, but the card records no reachable channel: nothing establishes a published, permitted way to contact the 90 registered coastal operators, so no sale can start.

alternatives.title: Sell the packs through the port-authority register
alternatives.why: The register establishes that 90 operators exist, not that their contacts are published or that outreach to them is permitted.

steps.label: Find a published, permitted channel to coastal ship operators (port-authority register contacts, association list, operators' own published contact pages) and how many it reaches

quantities.name: reachableBuyers
quantities.unit: operators reachable through a published channel
quantities.needs: A sourced published contact channel for coastal ship operators and the count it reaches

sources.claim: 90 coastal operators are registered with the port authority; each needs a pack per vessel each year.

noPlan.decisiveGap: REACHABLE_BUYER: the opening has no recorded channel through which coastal ship operators can be reached for this offer; every other link needed for two $2,500 sales is evidenced.
noPlan.resolution: Research and record a published, permitted contact channel (port-authority register with contacts, maritime association directory, or operators' published contact pages) with its source and the number of operators it reaches; with it, two sales at $2,500 within the 14-day time to cash meet the target.
